data.title: Pond Duck Adventures

challenges.instruction: Tap to bring 1 more ducks in!
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are swimming in the pond. 1 more duck joins them.

challenges.instruction: Tap 1 ducks to send them away!
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are resting near the water. 1 duck waddles away.

challenges.instruction: Tap to bring 2 more ducks in!
challenges.storyText: 1 lonely duck is swimming. 2 friends swim over to join.

challenges.instruction: Tap 2 ducks to send them away!
challenges.storyText: 4 ducks are splashing around. 2 ducks fly off.

challenges.instruction: Tap to bring 3 more ducks in!
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are diving for fish. 3 more ducks fly in to join.

challenges.instruction: Tap 3 ducks to send them away!
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are floating peacefully. All 3 ducks swim behind the reeds.

challenges.instruction: Tap to bring 4 more ducks in!
challenges.storyText: 1 duck is swimming alone. 4 new ducks arrive.

data.description: Children act out kindergarten addition and subtraction stories with cute pond ducks to build early math fluency.
